# GlobalHostia

> GlobalHostia (globalhostia.com) is a web hosting company based in Dubai, UAE, operated by Desert Tech Cloud Services LLC. It sells web hosting, managed WordPress hosting, cloud and VPS servers, dedicated servers, domains, SSL certificates and business email, with servers in Europe, the USA and Asia and 24/7 support.

Prices on the website are shown live from the GlobalHostia billing system (WHMCS) and can change; always link to the page rather than quoting a price. Orders, invoices and the client area run at https://my.globalhostia.com.

Contact: +971 50 734 1578 · support@globalhostia.com

## Hosting

- [Web hosting](https://globalhostia.com/web-hosting): NVMe shared hosting in the USA, Malaysia and Singapore with free SSL, email and daily backups
- [Shared hosting](https://globalhostia.com/shared-hosting): entry-level plans for small sites
- [Managed WordPress hosting](https://globalhostia.com/wordpress-hosting): caching, staging, automatic updates and backups
- [cPanel reseller hosting](https://globalhostia.com/cpanel-reseller): white-label reseller plans for agencies and new hosting businesses
- [Business email and Google Workspace](https://globalhostia.com/google-workspace): email on your own domain

## Servers

- [VPS hosting](https://globalhostia.com/vps-hosting): Linux and Windows VPS with dedicated vCPU, NVMe storage and root access
- [Cloud VPS and servers in Europe and the USA](https://globalhostia.com/cloud-servers): KVM VPS with configurable RAM, vCPU and disk
- [Cloud VPS (managed)](https://globalhostia.com/cloudvps-hosting): managed cloud VPS that scales with traffic
- [Dedicated servers](https://globalhostia.com/dedicated-servers): bare-metal Xeon and Ryzen servers
- [Windows RDP servers](https://globalhostia.com/windows-rdp) and [Linux RDP servers](https://globalhostia.com/linux-rdp): always-on remote desktop servers
- [Forex VPS](https://globalhostia.com/forex-vps): low-latency VPS for MetaTrader and trading bots
- [AI / LLM hosting](https://globalhostia.com/ai-llm-hosting): servers sized for private inference of open models
- [n8n automation hosting](https://globalhostia.com/n8n-automation): self-hosted n8n workflows on NVMe servers
- [Project management workspace](https://globalhostia.com/projects): hosted project management without per-seat pricing

## Domains and security

- [Domain registration](https://globalhostia.com/domains-registration): search, register and transfer domains with first-year and renewal prices shown
- [SSL certificates](https://globalhostia.com/ssl-certificate): DV, OV and EV certificates
